title: Existing-patient booking requests are handed to reception and trigger an internal SMS alert
description: The caller clearly says this is not a first visit, asks to book another visit, provides synthetic identity details in the first turn, confirms the repeated phone number, and should stay in the reception-task branch. When the internal SMS tool is available, the assistant should call sendSmsToReceptionists only after createReceptionTask succeeds and should reuse the created taskId.

turns.user: Dzien dobry, chce umowic kolejna wizyte na higienizacje. To nie jest moja pierwsza wizyta, bylem juz u was. Mam na imie Test Staly Pacjent SMS, moj numer to siedem zero dwa, zero zero trzy, zero zero dziewiec.

assertions.description: The assistant should not create the reception task before the caller confirms the repeated phone number.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant skipped the phone confirmation step before createReceptionTask

assertions.description: An existing-patient booking request should not enter direct scheduling before the handoff path is complete.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant ignored the existing-patient handoff policy and tried scheduling anyway

rubric.description: The assistant should create the reception task immediately after the caller confirms the repeated phone number.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant delayed the existing-patient handoff instead of creating the task on turn 2

rubric.description: The existing-patient booking request should create a reception task after confirmation.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant prompt or createReceptionTask workflow did not hand off the existing-patient booking request

rubric.description: The handoff should keep the existing_patient_booking task type.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant mapped the existing-patient booking request to the wrong task type

rubric.description: The handoff payload must not include a free-text summary field.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant is still sending free-text summary data in createReceptionTask

rubric.description: The handoff payload must not include a free-text notes field.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant is still sending free-text notes in createReceptionTask

rubric.description: The internal receptionist SMS should be triggered on the confirmation turn only.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant did not call sendSmsToReceptionists after the handoff task succeeded

rubric.description: The internal receptionist SMS should be triggered only after createReceptionTask has already returned its result.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant called sendSmsToReceptionists before createReceptionTask returned the taskId

rubric.description: The internal SMS workflow itself should accept the receptionist alert request.
rubric.root_cause_hint: sendSmsToReceptionists was called but the SMS workflow rejected or failed the request

rubric.description: The internal receptionist SMS must reuse the exact taskId returned by createReceptionTask.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant did not propagate the created taskId into sendSmsToReceptionists

rubric.description: The internal receptionist SMS payload should keep the existing_patient_booking task type.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant lost the handoff task type before the sendSmsToReceptionists call

rubric.description: An existing-patient booking handoff must not call checkAvailability.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to schedule the existing patient directly

rubric.description: An existing-patient booking handoff must not create a new calendar event.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant attempted to createEvent instead of staying in the handoff branch
